Name: Cloudflare Pages - Deploy
Description:
Triggers a deployment of a git-connected [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com) project via the [Pages deployment API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/pages/subresources/projects/subresources/deployments/methods/create/), and optionally waits for the build to finish — failing the step if the build fails.

The project's repository must already be connected and authorized in the Cloudflare Pages dashboard. Cloudflare decides the Pages environment from the branch alone (the project's production branch deploys to production, any other branch deploys a preview), so the step checks the branch against the chosen **Pages Environment** before deploying. By default, the Octopus `Production` environment deploys to Pages production and every other Octopus environment deploys a preview, which stops a Development or Staging deployment from going live by accident.

Cloudflare builds the latest commit on the branch. To make Octopus the only route to production, turn off automatic production deployments under the project's **Settings → Builds → Branch control**.

Sets the output variables `DeploymentId`, `DeploymentUrl`, `AliasUrl` (the stable branch URL of a preview, set when Wait For Completion is enabled), and `Environment` for use in later steps.

Requires `curl` and either `jq` or `python3` on the worker.

Properties.Octopus.Action.Script.ScriptBody:
#!/bin/bash

# Cloudflare Pages - Deploy
# Triggers a deployment of a git-connected Cloudflare Pages project via the REST API,
# optionally waiting for the build to finish.
# API reference: https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/resources/pages/subresources/projects/subresources/deployments/methods/create/

# Read step parameters
ApiToken=$(get_octopusvariable "CloudflarePages.ApiToken")
AccountId=$(get_octopusvariable "CloudflarePages.AccountId")
ProjectName=$(get_octopusvariable "CloudflarePages.ProjectName")
PagesEnvironment=$(get_octopusvariable "CloudflarePages.Environment")
Branch=$(get_octopusvariable "CloudflarePages.Branch")
WaitForCompletion=$(get_octopusvariable "CloudflarePages.WaitForCompletion")
TimeoutSeconds=$(get_octopusvariable "CloudflarePages.TimeoutSeconds")

# Validate required tooling

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: curl is required on the worker to run this step." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  JSON_TOOL="jq"
elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  JSON_TOOL="python3"
else
  echo "ERROR: jq or python3 is required on the worker to parse JSON." >&2
  exit 1
fi

# Reads JSON on stdin and prints the value at dotted path $1 (empty if missing
# or null; numeric path parts index into arrays)
json_get() {
  if [[ "$JSON_TOOL" == "jq" ]]; then
    jq -r "getpath(\"$1\" | split(\".\") | map(if test(\"^[0-9]+$\") then tonumber else . end)) // empty" 2>/dev/null
  else
    python3 -c '
import json, sys
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(0)
cur = data
for part in sys.argv[1].split("."):
    if isinstance(cur, dict) and part in cur:
        cur = cur[part]
    elif isinstance(cur, list) and part.isdigit() and int(part) < len(cur):
        cur = cur[int(part)]
    else:
        sys.exit(0)
if cur is None:
    sys.exit(0)
print(cur if not isinstance(cur, (dict, list)) else json.dumps(cur))
' "$1"
  fi
}

# Validate required parameters

if [[ -z "$ApiToken" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: API Token is required." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -z "$AccountId" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: Account ID is required." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -z "$ProjectName" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: Project Name is required." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -z "$TimeoutSeconds" ]]; then
  TimeoutSeconds=600
elif [[ ! "$TimeoutSeconds" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: Timeout must be a whole number of seconds (got '$TimeoutSeconds')." >&2
  exit 1
fi

PagesEnvironment=$(echo "$PagesEnvironment" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')

if [[ "$PagesEnvironment" != "production" && "$PagesEnvironment" != "preview" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: Pages Environment must be 'production' or 'preview' (got '$PagesEnvironment')." >&2
  exit 1
fi

PROJECT_URL="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/${AccountId}/pages/projects/${ProjectName}"

# Look up the project's production branch. Cloudflare decides the environment
# from the branch alone: the production branch deploys to production, any other
# branch deploys a preview.

RAW=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 60 --write-out $'\n%{http_code}' \
  --request GET "$PROJECT_URL" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $ApiToken")

CURL_EXIT=$?

if [[ $CURL_EXIT -ne 0 ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: curl request failed (exit code $CURL_EXIT)." >&2
  exit 1
fi

HTTP_STATUS=$(echo "$RAW" | tail -n 1)
RESPONSE=$(echo "$RAW" | sed '$d')

SUCCESS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "success")

if [[ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ge 400 || "$SUCCESS" != "True" && "$SUCCESS" != "true" ]]; then
  ERROR_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "errors.0.code")
  ERROR_MSG=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "errors.0.message")
  echo "ERROR: Could not read Pages project '$ProjectName' (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)." >&2
  [[ -n "$ERROR_CODE" ]] && echo "  Code   : $ERROR_CODE" >&2
  [[ -n "$ERROR_MSG" ]] && echo "  Message: $ERROR_MSG" >&2
  exit 1
fi

PRODUCTION_BRANCH=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "result.production_branch")

if [[ -z "$PRODUCTION_BRANCH" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: Pages project '$ProjectName' has no production branch. Only git-connected projects can be deployed by this step." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "$PagesEnvironment" == "production" ]]; then
  if [[ -z "$Branch" ]]; then
    Branch="$PRODUCTION_BRANCH"
  elif [[ "$Branch" != "$PRODUCTION_BRANCH" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Branch '$Branch' is not the project's production branch ('$PRODUCTION_BRANCH'), so Cloudflare would deploy it as a preview." >&2
    echo "Leave Branch blank to deploy '$PRODUCTION_BRANCH' to production, or set Pages Environment to 'preview'." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
else
  if [[ -z "$Branch" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Preview deployments need a Branch other than the production branch ('$PRODUCTION_BRANCH')." >&2
    exit 1
  elif [[ "$Branch" == "$PRODUCTION_BRANCH" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Branch '$Branch' is the project's production branch, so Cloudflare would deploy it to production, not a preview." >&2
    echo "Choose a different branch, or set Pages Environment to 'production'." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# Trigger the deployment

BASE_URL="${PROJECT_URL}/deployments"

echo "Triggering Cloudflare Pages deployment..."
echo "  Project    : $ProjectName"
echo "  Environment: $PagesEnvironment"
echo "  Branch     : $Branch"
echo ""

RAW=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 60 --write-out $'\n%{http_code}' \
  --request POST "$BASE_URL" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $ApiToken" \
  --form "branch=$Branch")

CURL_EXIT=$?

if [[ $CURL_EXIT -ne 0 ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: curl request failed (exit code $CURL_EXIT)." >&2
  exit 1
fi

HTTP_STATUS=$(echo "$RAW" | tail -n 1)
RESPONSE=$(echo "$RAW" | sed '$d')

SUCCESS=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "success")

if [[ "$HTTP_STATUS" -ge 400 || "$SUCCESS" != "True" && "$SUCCESS" != "true" ]]; then
  ERROR_CODE=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "errors.0.code")
  ERROR_MSG=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "errors.0.message")
  echo "ERROR: Cloudflare API returned an error (HTTP $HTTP_STATUS)." >&2
  [[ -n "$ERROR_CODE" ]] && echo "  Code   : $ERROR_CODE" >&2
  [[ -n "$ERROR_MSG" ]] && echo "  Message: $ERROR_MSG" >&2
  exit 1
fi

DEPLOY_ID=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "result.id")
DEPLOY_URL=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "result.url")
ENVIRONMENT=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "result.environment")
ALIAS_URL=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | json_get "result.aliases.0")

echo "Deployment created."
echo "  ID         : $DEPLOY_ID"
echo "  Environment: $ENVIRONMENT"
echo "  URL        : $DEPLOY_URL"
[[ -n "$ALIAS_URL" ]] && echo "  Alias      : $ALIAS_URL"

set_octopusvariable "DeploymentId" "$DEPLOY_ID"
set_octopusvariable "DeploymentUrl" "$DEPLOY_URL"
set_octopusvariable "AliasUrl" "$ALIAS_URL"
set_octopusvariable "Environment" "$ENVIRONMENT"

if [[ -n "$ENVIRONMENT" && "$ENVIRONMENT" != "$PagesEnvironment" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: Cloudflare created a $ENVIRONMENT deployment, but $PagesEnvironment was requested." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "$WaitForCompletion" != "True" ]]; then
  echo ""
  echo "Not waiting for the build to complete (Wait For Completion is disabled)."
  exit 0
fi

# Poll until the deployment succeeds, fails, or the timeout elapses

echo ""
echo "Waiting for the deployment to complete (timeout ${TimeoutSeconds}s)..."

POLL_INTERVAL=10
ELAPSED=0
LAST_STAGE=""

while true; do
  STATUS_RESPONSE=$(curl --silent --max-time 30 \
    --request GET "${BASE_URL}/${DEPLOY_ID}" \
    --header "Authorization: Bearer $ApiToken")

  STAGE_NAME=$(echo "$STATUS_RESPONSE" | json_get "result.latest_stage.name")
  STAGE_STATUS=$(echo "$STATUS_RESPONSE" | json_get "result.latest_stage.status")

  if [[ -n "$STAGE_NAME" && "${STAGE_NAME}:${STAGE_STATUS}" != "$LAST_STAGE" ]]; then
    echo "  [${ELAPSED}s] stage: $STAGE_NAME ($STAGE_STATUS)"
    LAST_STAGE="${STAGE_NAME}:${STAGE_STATUS}"
  fi

  if [[ "$STAGE_NAME" == "deploy" && "$STAGE_STATUS" == "success" ]]; then
    # Cloudflare only assigns the branch alias once the deployment is live
    [[ -z "$ALIAS_URL" ]] && ALIAS_URL=$(echo "$STATUS_RESPONSE" | json_get "result.aliases.0")

    echo ""
    echo "Deployment completed successfully!"
    echo "  URL  : $DEPLOY_URL"
    if [[ -n "$ALIAS_URL" ]]; then
      echo "  Alias: $ALIAS_URL"
      set_octopusvariable "AliasUrl" "$ALIAS_URL"
    fi
    exit 0
  fi

  if [[ "$STAGE_STATUS" == "failure" || "$STAGE_STATUS" == "canceled" ]]; then
    echo ""
    echo "ERROR: Deployment ${STAGE_STATUS} during the '$STAGE_NAME' stage." >&2
    echo "Check the build log in the Cloudflare dashboard for details." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  if (( ELAPSED >= TimeoutSeconds )); then
    echo ""
    echo "ERROR: Timed out after ${TimeoutSeconds}s waiting for the deployment to complete (last stage: $STAGE_NAME $STAGE_STATUS)." >&2
    echo "The build may still finish; check the Cloudflare dashboard." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  sleep "$POLL_INTERVAL"
  ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED + POLL_INTERVAL))
done

Parameters.Name: CloudflarePages.ApiToken
Parameters.Label: API Token
Parameters.HelpText: A Cloudflare [API token](https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/) with the `Account → Cloudflare Pages → Edit` permission. Consider binding this to a sensitive project variable so it can be scoped and rotated in one place.

Parameters.Name: CloudflarePages.AccountId
Parameters.Label: Account ID
Parameters.HelpText: The Cloudflare account ID, shown on the right of most zone pages and under **Workers & Pages** in the dashboard.

Parameters.Name: CloudflarePages.ProjectName
Parameters.Label: Project Name
Parameters.HelpText: The name of the Pages project (as shown in **Workers & Pages** in the dashboard).

Parameters.Name: CloudflarePages.Environment
Parameters.Label: Pages Environment
Parameters.HelpText: The Pages environment to deploy to. `Production` deploys the project's production branch; `Preview` deploys the branch given below, which must not be the production branch. The default maps the Octopus `Production` environment to Pages production and every other Octopus environment to a preview.

Parameters.Name: CloudflarePages.Branch
Parameters.Label: Branch
Parameters.HelpText: The git branch to build. For **Production**, leave blank to use the project's production branch. For **Preview**, required: a branch other than the production branch, such as `staging`. Scope this per Octopus environment (for example `#{Cloudflare.Pages.Branch}`) to give each environment its own preview branch and URL.

Parameters.Name: CloudflarePages.WaitForCompletion
Parameters.Label: Wait For Completion
Parameters.HelpText: If enabled, the step polls the deployment until the build succeeds or fails, and fails the step on a failed build. If disabled, the step succeeds as soon as the deployment is queued.

Parameters.Name: CloudflarePages.TimeoutSeconds
Parameters.Label: Timeout (seconds)
Parameters.HelpText: How long to wait for the build to complete before failing the step. Only used when Wait For Completion is enabled.
